name: Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust
summary: Operating as a specialized trust, Copper Property CTL Pass Through Trust offers various trust-related services. Its formation was specifically designed to facilitate the purchase of 160 retail locations and 6 warehouse distribution facilities from J.C. Penney. This acquisition represented a key element of J.C. Penney's Chapter 11 restructuring initiative, with the Trust's ultimate mandate being the subsequent liquidation of these entire holdings. The entity commenced its operations on December 12, 2020, and its corporate headquarters are situated in Jersey City, New Jersey.
